name: יֵשֶׁר
summary: A son of Caleb son of Hezron, of Judah, named once in the genealogy (1Ch 2:18). The name is a segholate noun of the root, “uprightness, straightness”, as יֹשֶׁר; scripture tells nothing more of him or of the name.

evidence.note: “Caleb son of Hezron fathered children by Azubah his wife and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher (יֵשֶׁר) and Shobab and Ardon.”
The noun יֹשֶׁר “uprightness”, which the name answers to.
“He who walks in his uprightness (בְּיָשְׁרוֹ) fears Yahweh”: the same noun with a suffix.

note: Takes j.dz.ad (1 token). The pointing יֵשֶׁר (the brief's lemma יֶשֶׁר is BDB's pausal headword) differs from the noun יֹשֶׁר; the reading “uprightness” rests on the form only.
